# NISHA STORE

> Ukrainian vintage & archive streetwear marketplace offering curated 1-of-1 garments, footwear, and accessories with buyer protection, Nova Poshta delivery across Ukraine, and direct price negotiation (bargain).

## Store Overview

- **Website**: https://www.nisha-store.shop/
- **Category**: Vintage, Archive & Streetwear Marketplace (Ukraine)
- **Inventory Model**: 1-of-1 authentic vintage and archive pieces (each item is unique)
- **Languages**: Ukrainian (`ua`, default), Russian (`ru`), English (`en`)
- **Currency**: UAH (Ukrainian Hryvnia)
- **Telegram Bot**: https://t.me/nisha_store1_bot

## Key Pages & Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [Main Catalog](https://www.nisha-store.shop/): Live searchable catalog with filters by category, brand, size, price, sale, and bargain eligibility
- [Return & Buyer Protection Policy](https://www.nisha-store.shop/return-policy): Detailed return, inspection, and deal guarantee terms
- [Product Feed (Google Merchant & Meta Catalog XML)](https://www.nisha-store.shop/feed.xml): Live RSS 2.0 XML product catalog with prices, sizes, conditions, and stock availability
- [XML Sitemap](https://www.nisha-store.shop/sitemap.xml): Canonical index of all available product pages and images

## Core Marketplace Features

- **Offer Your Price (Bargain)**: On eligible items, buyers can submit a custom offer directly to the seller/curator and receive a personal discounted price upon approval.
- **NISHA STUDIO**: Verified seller drops with escrow-style buyer protection handled by NISHA.
- **Nova Poshta Integration**: Fast city/branch/postomat lookup, delivery cost calculation, and live order tracking inside the "My Orders" cabinet.
- **Measurements & Condition Transparency**: Every listing includes detailed garment measurements, condition rating, and high-resolution photos.

## Delivery, Payment & Guarantee

- **Delivery**: Nova Poshta across Ukraine (same-day dispatch for orders confirmed before 16:00, or next business day).
- **Payment Options**: Full prepayment or Cash on Delivery (Nova Poshta) with a 200 UAH prepayment.
- **Buyer Protection**: Buyers inspect and try on items at the Nova Poshta branch before final acceptance. Selected archive items include a 14-day return/exchange guarantee; drop items are inspected at the branch.
